क्रिकेटर पृथ्वी शॉ और आकृति अग्रवाल ने अपनी मंगनी टूटने के कुछ ही हफ्तों बाद फिर से एक साथ आने का फैसला किया है। 🏏
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, अभिनेत्री आकृति ने खुद इस बात की पुष्टि की है कि वे दोनों दोबारा मिल गए हैं। 🤝
इससे पहले इन दोनों की छह महीने पुरानी मंगनी टूटने और कथित चीटिंग की अफवाहों ने सोशल मीडिया पर काफी तहलका मचाया था। 💔
अब जब ये दोनों फिर से साथ हैं, तो क्या आपको लगता है कि इनका रिश्ता इस बार लंबा टिकेगा? नीचे कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Scene Trailer Review: Suriya’s quirkiness makes him perfect match for Naslen’s psych mode; Drops homage to Thalapathy Vijay
ctx.summary:
Suriya starrer Scene is slated for a theatrical release on November 6, 2026, coinciding with Diwali this year. Now, the makers have unveiled the film’s trailer, promising a fun-filled and action-packed entertainer. 
 Scene Trailer Review 
 Running for 2 minutes and 40 seconds, the trailer introduces  Suriya  as officer Inbaraj, a cop known for his impressive search skills but also for his unruly, disrespectful, and bratty behavior. Paying homage to Thalapathy Vijay’s real-life speech, the character quits the force while being at the top of his game, only to launch an investigation against his arch-enemy, Eeswaran, on his own. 
 Watch the trailer here: 
 The trailer also introduces the quirky members of Inbaraj’s team, with  Nazriya Nazim Fahadh  playing Maya, one of the team members and the officer’s love interest. With his unconventional team by his side, whether Inbaraj manages to outsmart Eeswaran seems to be the central narrative of the Jithu Madhavan directorial. 
 Much like the filmmaker’s previous ventures, Romancham and Aavesham, the film appears to adopt a fun-filled narrative, even as serious incidents unfold in the background. With Suriya fully embracing his bratty character, Naslen looks like the perfect fit for a role that appears innocent yet ruthless. 
 Featuring wacky new tracks by Sushin Shyam and comic-book-style editing, Scene promises to be a refreshing entertainer designed for the big-screen experience.
